claim.claim-text: 1. A filter for use in a respiratory support system for delivering humidified gas at high flow rates to a user or patient, the filter comprising a filter housing, the filter housing comprising a gases inlet port and a gases outlet port, wherein at least one of said inlet and/or outlet port is adapted for connection with a connector provided at a terminal end of a conduit via at least a pair of male connection fingers extending externally from the inlet and/or outlet port.

2. The filter as claimed in claim 1, wherein the male connection fingers are configured to extend from said gases inlet and/or outlet port, and/or wherein the male connection fingers comprise indentations or recesses shaped for engagement of a projection or protrusion located or provided on the connector provided at the terminal end of the conduit

3. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein the gases inlet and/or outlet port comprise an adapter insert, said adapter insert configured to facilitate said connection with the connector provided at the terminal end of the conduit.

4. The filter as claimed in claim 3, wherein the adapter insert comprises one or more or a plurality of retention members, each said retention member substantially engageable with an interior surface portion of the filter housing, and/or

wherein each retention member is configured for an engagement with an interior surface of the filter housing to retain said adapter insert within a said port into which said adapter is inserted and/or, wherein each said retention member may be configured to resist axial displacement of said adapter in a direction toward an exterior end of a said port and/or, wherein each said retention member comprises at least a hook or other surface projection to engage or latch with an internal surface of said filter housing, and/or wherein the adapter insert comprises at least four retention members.

5. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 3 or 4, wherein the adapter insert comprises a first end from which said male connection fingers extend, a second end from which the one or more retention members extend, and a shank portion connecting of the first end with the second end, where the shank portion comprises a lumen or gas flow path for the passage of gases therethrough between each of the first end and second end.

6. The filter as claimed in claim 5, wherein the adapter insert comprises at least a first sealing member provided about the shank portion and at least a second sealing member provided substantially at or adjacent with a first end of the adapter insert,

wherein the first sealing member is provided about a circumference of the shank portion, and/or wherein the first sealing member is configured to provide a first sealing surface extending radially outwardly from the shank portion.

7. The filter as claimed in claim 6, wherein the first sealing member is configured to provide a first sealing surface for sealing with an internal surface of a said port of the filter housing, and/or wherein the first sealing member is located intermediate of a first end and a second end of the adapter insert.

8. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 6 or 7, wherein the second sealing member is located substantially at or adjacent with a base of the male connection fingers as said male connection fingers extend from a first end of the adapter insert.
9. The filter as claimed in claim 6, wherein the first end of the adapter insert comprises a radially extensive ledge or lip,

wherein the second sealing member is located substantially upon an upper-side surface of the ledge or lip, and/or wherein the ledge or lip extends radially outwardly so as to have an outside diameter that is equal to or less than the outside diameter of a said port within which said adapter insert is located, or an outside diameter that is greater than an inside diameter of a said port within which said adapter insert is located, and/or wherein an underside surface of said ledge or lip contacts a terminal end face of a said port within which said adapter insert is located.

10. The filter as claimed in claim 9, wherein a distance between an underside surface of the ledge or lip and a retaining member matches or is substantially equal to a length of a said port from into which said adapter insert is located, and/or

wherein the ledge or lip is interposed or may be sandwiched between an end of the shank portion and a first end of the adapter insert, and/or wherein the ledge or lip is sandwiched between a base of said male connection fingers and an end of the shank portion.
11. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 9 or 10, wherein the second sealing member is sandwiched between a base of said male connection fingers and an end of the shank portion, and/or

wherein the second sealing member is sandwiched between a base of said male connection fingers and an upper-side surface of the ledge or lip, and/or wherein the second sealing member provides for a second sealing surface for sealing with a surface of the connector provided at the terminal end of the conduit, brought to bear upon said second sealing surface.
12. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 6 to 11, wherein either or both the first and second sealing members are an o-ring.
13. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 5 to 12, wherein one or more splines or ribs may be located about the shank portion, and

wherein the one or more splines or ribs extend longitudinally along the shank portion, and/or wherein the one or more splines or ribs extend a radial distance outward from the shank portion so as to at least partially engage or make surface contact with an inside surface of a said port into which said adapter insert is located, and/or wherein one or each of the one or more splines or ribs may be configured to provide strengthening or structural support of a wall of a said port into which said adapter insert is to be located.

14. The filter as claimed in any one of claims 5 to 13, wherein the lumen or gas flow path transitions from a substantially wider bore or larger internal diameter at a second end of the adapter insert to a substantially narrower bore or a smaller internal diameter at a first end of the adapter insert, wherein the lumen or gas flow path transition comprises a substantially graduated, or a substantially linear, progression between the different bores or internal diameters between end of the first and second ends.
